concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-grabpay]] — 2026-09-15 GrabPay overview for shopper redirect, Wallet/PayLater geography, Wallets capability matrix, refund-reference rule and channel routes; the matrix is Wallets-scoped, and shopper confirmation is not merchant payment-outcome proof.
warnings: The MY/PH/SG and MYR/PHP/SGD lists are not an explicit country-to-currency pairing or merchant-eligibility guarantee.
The capability matrix labels Wallets, so do not extend its recurring/capture/refund/chargeback marks to PayLater without separate evidence.
